cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; grep -n -i -C2 "menu\|dropdown" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu; grep -n -A30 "Button view\|## Icon" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -80

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu; ls $D; cat $D/DropdownMenu.d.ts $D/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; curl -s -m 15 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt | grep -n -i -A40 "dropdownmenu" | head -120

grep -n -A25 "interface MenuItemProps\|type MenuItemProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/*/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40
